title: Database schema: users, vault, folders, 2FA, audit, dormant orgs
description: Create the forward-only migration that defines every MVP table, index, and constraint, plus dormant organization tables reserved for phase 2. Requirement IDs: TASK-7 through TASK-12.
acceptanceCriteria: `users` table has all PRD columns, a case-insensitive unique email constraint, and an email index
`vault_items` has an index on `(user_id, rev)`, `(user_id, deleted_at)`, `(user_id, folder_id)`, and `(user_id, type)`
`folders` stores only ciphertext names and metadata
`user_2fa` and `backup_codes` support TOTP enrollment, replay protection, and one-time code use
`audit_events` has an index on `(user_id, created_at)` and no column intended for secrets
Dormant `orgs`, `org_members`, `collections`, `collection_items` tables exist and are referenced by no route
Migration applies cleanly to a fresh local D1 and to the test database
A D1 inspection shows no column capable of holding plaintext vault content beyond identifiers and metadata

steps.details: Create `migrations/0002_users.sql`. Columns per PRD §8: id TEXT PK, email TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE NOCASE UNIQUE, display_name, auth_hash, server_salt, kdf_alg, kdf_iterations, kdf_salt, vault_key_wrapped, vault_key_wrap_iv, recovery_key_wrapped, recovery_key_wrap_iv, role CHECK(role IN ('admin','member')), status CHECK(status IN ('active','disabled')), vault_rev INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, failed_login_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, locked_until INTEGER, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL. Add `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_users_email ON users(email)`.

Create `migrations/0003_vault.sql`. `vault_items(id TEXT PK, user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, org_id TEXT NULL, folder_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES folders(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(type IN ('login','note')), favorite INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, data_ct TEXT NOT NULL, data_iv TEXT NOT NULL, data_version INTEGER NOT NULL, rev INTEGER NOT NULL, deleted_at INTEGER, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)`. `folders(id TEXT PK, user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, name_ct TEXT NOT NULL, name_iv TEXT NOT NULL, data_version INTEGER NOT NULL, rev INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at, updated_at)`. Add the four vault indexes and a folders user index.

Create `migrations/0004_two_factor.sql`. `user_2fa(user_id TEXT PK REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, totp_secret_ct TEXT NOT NULL, totp_secret_iv TEXT NOT NULL, enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_totp_step INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at, updated_at)`. `backup_codes(id TEXT PK, user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, code_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, used_at INTEGER, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)` with an index on `(user_id, used_at)`.

Create `migrations/0005_audit.sql`. `audit_events(id TEXT PK, user_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, type TEXT NOT NULL, ip_hash TEXT, ua_hash TEXT, metadata TEXT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)` with `CREATE INDEX idx_audit_user_time ON audit_events(user_id, created_at)`.

Create `migrations/0006_orgs_dormant.sql` with orgs, org_members (role owner|admin|member), collections, and collection_items. Add a header comment stating these tables are unused in MVP and must not be exposed by any route.

Run `pnpm db:migrate:local`. Execute `npx wrangler d1 execute bridgewarden-db --local --command "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'"` and `PRAGMA index_list('vault_items')` to confirm tables and indexes. Apply to the test database via `pnpm test`.

Insert a user twice with different case emails and confirm the second fails. Insert a user, a folder, and an item; delete the user and confirm cascade removes all rows; delete a folder and confirm the item survives with `folder_id` NULL.

technicalNotes: D1 is SQLite; timestamps are integer epoch milliseconds.
D1 enforces foreign keys when declared; verify ON DELETE behavior empirically rather than assuming.
Do not store plaintext item names anywhere; folder names are ciphertext too.
The email unique index must be case-insensitive via COLLATE NOCASE.
Never add a column for plaintext vault content, even temporarily.

pullRequest.title: feat(db): add MVP schema and dormant organization tables
pullRequest.scope: Migrations for users, vault_items, folders, 2FA, backup codes, audit events, and dormant org tables.
pullRequest.outOfScope: Query helpers, API handlers, seed data, and any route using the tables.
